heroSub: Northvane provides advanced sensing, autonomy, and secure communications architecture to support NATO and European Union defence and aerospace requirements.

intro.heading: Precision engineering for modern operational security
intro.body: We design and manufacture high-integrity hardware and software for critical mission environments. Our solutions ensure data integrity and situational awareness across multiple domains.

capabilities.name: Multi-spectral Sensing
capabilities.summary: High-fidelity detection systems designed for persistent surveillance in contested environments.
capabilities.description: Our sensor suites integrate electromagnetic and optical data to provide comprehensive situational awareness. These systems are engineered to operate under extreme thermal and kinetic conditions. We focus on reducing false-alarm rates through advanced signal processing.

features.title: Signal processing
features.text: Real-time data filtering reduces noise in high-interference zones.

features.title: Thermal resilience
features.text: Hardware maintains calibration across wide temperature gradients.

features.title: Modular architecture
features.text: Sensor heads can be swapped based on mission profiles.

features.title: Low-latency output
features.text: Direct data feeds ensure immediate operator response.

capabilities.name: Autonomous Navigation
capabilities.summary: Reliable guidance and control systems for unmanned platforms.
capabilities.description: We develop flight control logic and navigation algorithms for autonomous aerial vehicles. Our systems prioritise predictable behaviour in GPS-denied environments. We ensure all autonomous routines comply with strict safety protocols.

features.title: Inertial navigation
features.text: Maintains positional accuracy without external satellite signals.

features.title: Obstacle avoidance
features.text: Real-time spatial mapping prevents collisions in complex terrain.

features.title: Edge computing
features.text: On-board processing minimises reliance on ground links.

features.title: Fail-safe logic
features.text: Automated recovery protocols activate upon system fault detection.

capabilities.name: Secure Communications
capabilities.summary: Resilient data links for tactical command and control.
capabilities.description: Our communication systems provide encrypted, low-probability-of-intercept links for ground forces. We focus on maintaining connectivity in electromagnetically dense environments. The hardware is ruggedised for deployment in field conditions.

features.title: AES-256 encryption
features.text: Hardware-level encryption secures all transmitted data packets.

features.title: Frequency hopping
features.text: Rapid channel switching mitigates electronic jamming attempts.

features.title: Mesh networking
features.text: Nodes automatically establish links to extend range.

features.title: Compact form factor
features.text: Designed for integration into existing tactical radios.

capabilities.name: Orbital Infrastructure
capabilities.summary: Specialised components for small satellite constellations.
capabilities.description: We manufacture high-reliability subsystems for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) missions. Our engineering focuses on radiation hardening and thermal management in vacuum. We support the growing demand for secure orbital data relays.

features.title: Radiation hardening
features.text: Components are tested against total ionizing dose effects.

features.title: Thermal control
features.text: Passive and active heat dissipation systems integrated.

features.title: Compact bus
features.text: Optimised for CubeSat and SmallSat architectures.

features.title: Telemetry modules
features.text: Continuous health monitoring for long-duration missions.

approach.title: Requirement Analysis
approach.text: We define technical parameters alongside customer stakeholders.

approach.title: System Design
approach.text: Engineering teams develop high-fidelity digital models and prototypes.

approach.title: Rigorous Testing
approach.text: Environmental and security validation occurs in controlled laboratories.

approach.title: In-Service Support
approach.text: Continuous technical assistance and hardware updates follow deployment.

about.heading: Engineering reliability for sovereign security
body: Northvane Defence Systems was established in 2009 to address the growing need for integrated, secure technology in the European defence sector. We operate from our headquarters in Lisbon, supported by specialist engineering hubs in Toulouse and Gothenburg.

Our multidisciplinary teams focus on the intersection of hardware reliability and software intelligence. By maintaining control over the entire design lifecycle, we ensure that our systems meet the stringent requirements of NATO and EU partners.

We prioritise long-term stability and technical precision over rapid, unverified iterations. This disciplined approach allows us to deliver mission-critical systems that function reliably in the most demanding operational theatres.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: We maintain strict adherence to technical specifications.

values.title: Precision
values.text: Engineering accuracy is fundamental to our design process.

values.title: Resilience
values.text: Our systems are built for extreme environments.
